formRaceEntries.comment: Same sire as Lunar Fox out of a city placed three time winner. Second and first in Flemington jumpouts.
By sire of Bustling & dam is a half to two Listed winners. .Third in Seymour & Bendigo jumpouts. Betting?
Too green and wide at Cranbourne but much better at Sale, game having worked hard out wide on pace. Go close.
Resumes. 3rd of 5 Kyneton jumpout. Failed to fire at debut, much better at 2nd go. Never likely at only summer outing.
Same sire as Nepotism out of a dual city winner. First and second in latest Cranbourne jumpouts.
Raced outside leader fresh, gave a kick, collared on line. Won a Bendigo jumpout since so look for another bold showing.
Same sire as Rey Magnerio out of 3 time winning dam of 3 time winner Thinking Of Gerty. 3rd in latest Bendigo j'out.
Has not been too far away of late and is in with an each-way show.
Resumes having been unplaced in a local jumpout. Found trouble at debut, covering ground latest. Due some luck.
Trialled well prior to resuming but was never a threat at big odds. Like to see again.
